title: Starter Deck 31: RED Monkey.D.Luffy
note: Copiado da optcgapi.com para os testes e para o primeiro início do servidor. A importação (npm run cards:import) tem prioridade sobre estes dados.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type card other than [Nami] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
notes: Disclaimer: This card is a reprint of a previous card. While the original print is exclusively available in foil, this version is exclusively available as non-foil.
